searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keywords or phrases. Each one is fetched separately and returns one result row.

geo.title: Country or region code
geo.description: ISO code like US, GB, DE, or US-CA. Leave empty for worldwide.

category.title: Category ID
category.description: Google Trends category number, 0 for all categories.

property.title: Search type
property.description: Which Google search the trend data comes from.

relatedTopics.title: Related topics
relatedTopics.description: Top and rising related topics (best effort: Google often withholds these from automated sessions, so the field may be empty).

trendingNow.title: Also get today's trending searches
trendingNow.description: Adds one row per currently trending search in the chosen country, with traffic and news links.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language for names, e.g. en-US, de, es.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Leave off to use our built-in residential proxy, included in the price.
